# Health and Safety International

> A comprehensive global resource for workplace safety news, incident reporting, and occupational health guidance across construction, oil & gas, and manufacturing sectors.

Health and Safety International provides regional hubs for Europe and the Middle East, covering workplace safety compliance, industry updates, and professional development through news, features, webinars, and events. The platform serves EHS professionals and safety stakeholders with incident reports, technical guides, and expert interviews.

## Key Topics

- workplace-safety

## News & Industry Updates

- [News](https://healthandsafetyinternational.com/news): News hub covering workplace safety incidents and industry updates globally
- [Oil & Gas](https://healthandsafetyinternational.com/news/oil-and-gas): Oil and gas sector news covering drilling operations and incident reports
- [Construction](https://healthandsafetyinternational.com/news/construction): Construction industry news on workplace safety and regulatory compliance
- [Manufacturing](https://healthandsafetyinternational.com/news/manufacturing): Manufacturing sector coverage of workplace safety and occupational health
- [More News](https://healthandsafetyinternational.com/news/more): Additional news coverage across health and safety sectors and industries

## Safety Guides & Technical Resources

- [HEIGHT SAFETY](https://healthandsafetyinternational.com/features/height-safety): Height safety guide covering working at height, fall prevention and standards
- [GAS DETECTION](https://healthandsafetyinternational.com/features/gasdetection): Gas detection guide covering monitoring, leak detection and safety equipment
- [PPE](https://healthandsafetyinternational.com/features/personal-protective-equipment): Personal protective equipment guide covering standards and compliance
- [Features](https://healthandsafetyinternational.com/features): Featured articles on PPE, AI, respiratory protection and safety technology
- [More Features](https://healthandsafetyinternational.com/features/more): Additional safety features on hazard management and protective equipment
